items.quote: It is a growable table keyed by a connection's pool index (`conn->cpid`) holding `struct connectdata *`.

items.quote: a hash table keyed by the connection destination string (`conn->destination`) whose values are pointers to `struct cpool_bundle` objects (`lib/conncache.c`). A bundle is a refcounted `struct uint32_spbset` (sparse bitset, `lib/uint-spbset.h`) of the `cpid`s of all pooled connections to that same destination.

items.quote: a bitset of the `cpid`s of connections that are currently idle (not attached to a transfer). It enables fast eviction scans: `cpool_get_oldest_idle()` walks this set to find the longest-idle connection

items.quote: set from the `share` argument; `NULL` when the multi handle owns the pool, non-NULL when a `curl_share` does. It drives two behaviors in `lib/conncache.c`: (a) the `CPOOL_LOCK`/`CPOOL_UNLOCK` macros call `Curl_share_lock_share()`/`Curl_share_unlock_share()` on `CURL_LOCK_DATA_CONNECT`

items.quote: A bundle is a refcounted `struct uint32_spbset` (sparse bitset, `lib/uint-spbset.h`) of the `cpid`s of all pooled connections to that same destination. Bundles are registered via `Curl_hash_add()` in `cpool_bundle_add_id()` and unregistered via `Curl_hash_delete()` when empty
